svg: <g fill='{fill}' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{vsw}'>{#repeat i n}<ellipse cx='{50+28*sin(i*2*PI/n)}' cy='{50-28*cos(i*2*PI/n)}' rx='{50*petal*0.62}' ry='{50*petal}' transform='rotate({i*360/n},{50+28*sin(i*2*PI/n)},{50-28*cos(i*2*PI/n)})'/>{/repeat}<circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30'/></g>

name: Atom
description: Atom: three crossing elliptical orbits with dots
svg: <g fill='none' stroke='{stroke}' stroke-width='{rawSw}'><ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='46' ry='17' transform='rotate(45 50 50)'/><ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='46' ry='17' transform='rotate(-45 50 50)'/></g><g fill='{stroke}'><circle cx='17' cy='17' r='{rawSw*0.9}'/><circle cx='66' cy='34' r='{rawSw*0.9}'/><circle cx='33' cy='83' r='{rawSw*0.9}'/><circle cx='83' cy='83' r='{rawSw*0.9}'/></g>
